name: Product Recall
description: Product recall insurance covering food & beverage manufacturers, consumer goods, pharmaceuticals and automotive. Covers recall costs, business interruption, loss of profit and third party liability.

name: Upstream / Offshore Energy
description: Upstream and offshore energy insurance covering exploration and production assets, drilling rigs, production platforms, FPSOs, subsea infrastructure, marine support vessels and control of well operations.

name: Renewable Energy – Offshore
description: Offshore renewable energy insurance covering operational and construction wind farms, wave and tidal energy installations, offshore substations, export cables and O&M vessels.

name: Renewable Energy – Onshore
description: Onshore renewable energy insurance covering operational and construction wind farms, solar PV and CSP installations, battery energy storage systems (BESS), biomass and hydro plants.

name: Downstream / Onshore Energy
description: Downstream and onshore energy insurance covering refineries, petrochemical plants, pipelines, LNG terminals, power generation facilities (non-renewable) and industrial energy assets. Includes process safety management, Nat-CAT exposure, VCE/fire perils and BI.

name: Environmental Liability
description: Environmental impairment liability (EIL) and pollution liability insurance covering gradual and sudden pollution, third party bodily injury, property damage, cleanup costs and regulatory defence.

name: Cyber
description: Cyber insurance covering data breach response, business interruption from network outages, ransomware, cyber extortion, privacy liability, regulatory fines and cyber property damage.

name: Directors & Officers (D&O)
description: Directors and officers liability insurance protecting executives and board members against claims alleging wrongful acts, breach of fiduciary duty, misrepresentation and corporate governance failures. Includes EPL (employment practices liability) and fiduciary liability.

name: Employment Practices Liability (EPLI)
description: Employment practices liability insurance covering wrongful termination, discrimination (race, sex, age, disability), sexual harassment, retaliation, failure to promote and pay equity claims. D6 covers US risks under Title VII/ADEA/ADA; D7 covers non-US risks under Equality Act 2010 and local equivalents.

name: Transactional Liability (W&I / Tax)
description: Transactional liability insurance covering M&A warranty and indemnity (W&I), tax liability and contingent/contested risk policies supporting corporate transactions.

name: PI E&O – Legal Professions
description: Professional indemnity insurance for solicitors, barristers, law firms and legal professionals covering negligence, errors and omissions, breach of duty and civil liability claims.

name: PI E&O – Accountants
description: Professional indemnity for accountants, auditors, tax advisers and financial professionals covering negligent audit opinions, tax advice errors and financial statement misstatements.

name: PI E&O – Construction & Engineering
description: Professional indemnity for architects, engineers, surveyors, designers and design-and-build contractors covering design defects, specification errors, professional negligence and Building Safety Act 2022 obligations.

name: PI E&O – Technology & Telecom
description: Technology professional indemnity and errors & omissions insurance for IT companies, software developers, telecoms providers and technology service firms.

name: PI E&O – Financial Institutions
description: Professional indemnity and errors & omissions for banks, IFAs, asset managers, DFMs, stockbrokers and financial services firms. Covers negligent advice, mis-selling (pensions, endowments, structured products), regulatory defence costs, and emerging ESG and crypto claims. F2 direct; F3 facultative RI.

name: PI E&O – Miscellaneous
description: Miscellaneous professional indemnity and errors and omissions insurance covering the broad catch-all segment of professions not covered by specialist Lloyd's PI codes. E8: direct miscellaneous PI (management consultants, insurance brokers, estate agents, HR/recruitment consultants, property managers, training providers, healthcare non-medical, environmental consultants, ESG advisers); E9: binder/XOL arrangements for miscellaneous PI MGA portfolios; ED: design professionals (architects design/specification, interior designers, graphic/brand designers, industrial/product designers, urban planners); EE: miscellaneous E&O adjacent to US market (advertising agencies, PR/communications, travel agents, event managers, customs brokers, employee benefits consultants). All codes: claims-made basis; retroactive date the critical policy term; Insurance Act 2015 fair presentation; FCA Consumer Duty impact on insurance broker PI; Building Safety Act 2022 post-Grenfell impact on architects (ED); ESG advisory as emerging E8 sub-class.

name: Crime / Fidelity – Financial Institutions
description: Fidelity, bankers blanket bond and computer crime insurance for banks, investment firms and financial institutions covering employee dishonesty, forgery, electronic crime and social engineering fraud.

Fidelity, bankers blanket bond and computer crime insurance for banks, investment firms and financial institutions covering employee dishonesty, forgery, electronic crime and social engineering fraud. Covers Bankers Blanket Bond (BBB) origins, discovery basis, manifest intent trigger, computer crime vs BEC boundary, SWIFT CSP, FINRA Rule 4360, ICA 1940 §17(g), multinational programme structure, rogue trader history (Barings, SocGen, Adoboli) and landmark coverage cases (Medidata, Bangladesh Bank SWIFT heist).

name: Crime / Fidelity – Commercial
description: Commercial crime insurance for corporate entities (non-financial institutions) covering employee dishonesty, forgery and alteration, computer fraud, funds transfer fraud (EFT), social engineering/BEC, money and securities, and ERISA fidelity bonds. Covers obligor model distinctions from BB, ISO CR 00 21 standard form, discovery basis trigger, Medidata/Apache BEC circuit split, ERISA §412 bond requirements, ECCTA 2023 failure to prevent fraud offence, and multinational programme structure with DIC/DIL.

name: Commercial Property
description: Commercial property insurance for buildings, contents, stock and business interruption across primary, full-value, excess and binder platforms. P codes cover direct/fac property; B codes cover binding authority. Encompasses fire and allied perils, all-risks, catastrophe nat cat and specialist risks for UK, US, international and global programmes.

name: Engineering & Construction
description: Engineering insurance covering contractors all risk (CAR), erection all risk (EAR), machinery breakdown, boiler & machinery and contract works for annual and single-project construction risks.

name: General Liability – USA
description: Non-marine general and miscellaneous liability insurance for US risks covering public liability, products liability, completed operations, premises liability and umbrella/excess coverage.

name: General Liability – Non-USA
description: Non-marine general and miscellaneous liability insurance for non-US risks covering public liability, products liability, premises and operations liability worldwide (excluding USA).

name: Employers Liability – UK
description: UK employers liability insurance covering employee injury and illness arising from work activities, a compulsory cover for UK employers under the Employers Liability (Compulsory Insurance) Act 1969.

name: Workers Comp / EL – International
description: International workers compensation and employers liability for multinational workforces outside the USA and UK, covering statutory workers comp obligations and employer liability globally.

name: Workers Compensation – USA
description: US workers compensation insurance covering statutory workers comp benefits for injured employees and employer's liability, including per-person and catastrophe-exposed programmes.

name: Marine Hull
description: Marine hull insurance covering physical damage to oceangoing vessels including tankers, bulk carriers, containerships, passenger ships and their machinery, plus total loss only and loss of hire.

name: Marine Hull War
description: Marine hull war risk insurance covering vessels against war, strikes, piracy, terrorism, confiscation and related political violence perils under Institute War & Strikes Clauses Hulls—Time (CL.280, 1983). Includes AWRP for JWC Listed Areas (Red Sea, Black Sea, Gulf of Guinea), aviation war (AW/AVN52), binder business (WB), and extended/miscellaneous war perils (WX).

name: Marine Cargo
description: Marine cargo insurance covering goods in transit by sea, air, road and rail. Covers ICC (A) all risks, ICC (B) and (C) named perils, open cover, stock throughput, commodity trade finance, cargo war & strikes, cargo liability (VL) for freight forwarders, and special risks (VX) including fine art, project cargo, bulk commodities, and temperature-sensitive pharmaceuticals. Includes General Average, Incoterms 2020 insurable interest, accumulation risk management, and Red Sea/Suez disruption analysis.

name: Marine Liability
description: Marine legal liability insurance covering port operators, charterers, ship repairers, stevedores and other marine contractors for third party liability, pollution and collision liability.

name: Yachts
description: Yacht and pleasure craft insurance covering sailing yachts, motor yachts, superyachts and racing vessels for hull damage, third party liability, personal accident and war risks.

name: UK Household Property
description: UK household property insurance at Lloyd's covering high-net-worth homes, non-standard construction (listed, thatched, timber frame, concrete frame), flood-risk properties, let and holiday homes, and unoccupied properties. Includes Flood Re interaction, FCA GIPP pricing reform, BCIS rebuild cost methodology, and HNW agreed value structures.

name: Aviation Insurance
description: Comprehensive aviation insurance covering airline and general aviation hull (H2/H3), airline and GA liability including passenger, cargo and third-party (L2/L3), aviation products liability for aerospace manufacturers (AO), and airport owners & operators liability (AP).

name: Personal Accident & Health
description: Personal accident and health insurance covering accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D), permanent total and partial disability, temporary disability, private medical insurance (PMI), group income protection, travel insurance, sports career-ending disability, creditor protection and maritime crew PA and kidnap & ransom. Covers Lloyd's K-series codes: KA (individual PA), KB (PA binder), KC (contingency/medical expenses), KG (group A&H), KM (maritime PA/crew K&R), KP (creditor protection/PPI), KS (sports disability), KT (travel insurance), KX (miscellaneous A&H).

name: Medical Malpractice & Healthcare
description: Medical malpractice and healthcare liability insurance for hospitals, institutional healthcare providers, individual medical professionals and long-term care providers in the USA and internationally.

name: Motor – UK
description: UK motor insurance covering private cars, motorcycles, fleet and commercial vehicles with comprehensive and non-comprehensive coverage including third party, fire and theft.

name: Motor – International
description: International motor insurance covering vehicles in the USA, Canada, EU/EEA and rest of world including physical damage, third party liability and combined motor programmes.

name: Political Risk
description: Political risk insurance covering CEND (confiscation, expropriation, nationalisation, deprivation), political violence, currency inconvertibility, contract frustration, forced abandonment, non-honoring of sovereign obligations and arbitral award default. Covers bilateral investment treaty (BIT) framework, ICSID arbitration, MIGA/ECA co-insurance, resource nationalism history, country risk tiers, Russia/Ukraine market impact, and global programme structure.

name: Credit & Contract Frustration
description: Trade credit insurance covering buyer default, protracted default and insolvency (CR single-risk, WT whole turnover); contract frustration insurance for frustrated export contracts caused by government action, import/export prohibition, sovereign cancellation and currency inconvertibility/transfer restriction (CF); and whole turnover annual policies covering entire debtor books. Covers OECD country risk categories 0–7, OECD Arrangement MPRs, Berne Union/ICISA statistics, ECA co-insurance (UKEF, COFACE, Allianz Trade, Atradius), APH three-to-five year loss history rating, discretionary credit limit (DCL), waiting periods 90–180 days, indemnity 85–95%, Argentine default 2001, GFC 2008–2009, Greensill Capital 2021, COVID guarantee schemes, Russia/Ukraine 2022 CF, and EM sovereign stress (Sri Lanka, Zambia, Pakistan).

name: Terrorism & Political Violence
description: Standalone terrorism and political violence insurance covering acts of terrorism, riots, civil commotion, strikes, sabotage, active assailant and war on land for property and liability.

name: Event Cancellation & Contingency
description: Event cancellation, abandonment and non-appearance insurance for concerts, sporting events, conferences and exhibitions; pandemic cover; prize indemnity; and miscellaneous contingency.

name: Agricultural Crop & Forestry
description: Agricultural crop and forestry insurance covering multi-peril crop insurance (MPCI), named-peril crop (hail, frost, flood), revenue protection, weather index, standing timber fire and windstorm, timber merchants stock, and XOL treaty reinsurance. Covers USDA RMA/FCIC framework, PMFBY India, Agroseguro Spain, APH rating, WUI fire loading, FSC certification credits, Lothar 1999, 2012 US drought, BC bark beetle, ASF China, and Australian Black Summer.

name: Livestock & Bloodstock
description: Livestock and bloodstock insurance covering mortality and loss of use of horses, cattle, exotic animals and farm livestock including XOL reinsurance.

name: Fine Art, Specie & Jewellery
description: Fine art, specie, jewellery and cash in transit insurance covering fine art collections, museum exhibits, general specie, vault risks, jewellers block and armoured carrier operations.

name: Space
description: Space insurance covering satellite construction (SC), launch and early orbit phase (SL), and in-orbit annual cover (SO) for GEO, LEO and deep space missions. Includes launch vehicle reliability, debris mitigation, partial loss valuation, mega-constellation portfolio cover and third-party liability.

name: Nuclear
description: Nuclear insurance covering physical damage to nuclear power plants and liability arising from nuclear incidents including pools-backed nuclear property damage and nuclear liability.

name: Film & Entertainment
description: Film insurance covering production risks including cast insurance, negative film, faulty stock, props, sets and costumes, production delay and completion bonds.

name: Extended Warranty
description: Extended warranty insurance backing manufacturer, retailer and third-party warranty programmes for consumer electronics, white goods, motor MBI, EV batteries and home warranty. Covers obligor model (CLIP), insurance model, F×S underwriting, loss ratio benchmarks by segment, obsolescence risk, EV battery degradation, quota share and stop-loss programme structures, and global regulatory frameworks (FCA Consumer Duty, Magnuson-Moss, EU Right to Repair 2024).

name: Legal Expenses
description: Legal expenses insurance (LEI) covering legal costs for individuals and businesses in employment disputes, contract disputes, property disputes, personal injury and tax enquiries.

name: Temporary Life & Permanent Health
description: Temporary life (term assurance) and permanent health insurance (income protection/PHI) covering group life, group income protection, critical illness, impaired lives and long-term disability.

name: Difference in Conditions
description: Difference in conditions (DIC) and difference in limits (DIL) insurance providing excess coverage above local admitted policies within multinational insurance programmes.

name: Aviation War & Confiscation
description: Aviation war and confiscation insurance covering hull war, liability war, hijacking, confiscation/expropriation of aircraft, terrorism and allied perils under AVN 48B and related wordings.

name: Mortgage, Title, Surety & Financial Guarantee
description: Specialist financial lines insurance including mortgage indemnity, title insurance for property transactions, surety bonds for construction and contract performance, and financial guarantees.
